request.prompt: Scene: the Chapel of Hours, near view at a player's eye height inside the nave, dim dusk light through a broken rose window, rain falling through holes in the roof. A tall ruined stone nave with pointed arches and broken pews. At the east end, on the altar, lies a large curved shard of a bronze bell, faintly humming with a pale light. Beside the altar an iron hook on the wall, empty.
